name: Dermot Naughten
career_history: Associate Director at Turner & Townsend, 1/2025 to present; PMO - Project Delivery Lead - Cost & Project Manager at Arcadis, 1/2021 to 12/2024; Operations Project Manager at Landmark Construction, 1/2019 to 12/2020; Project Controls Manager at Linesight, 1/2017 to 12/2018; Project & Cost Manager (Quantity Surveyor) at Midgard, 1/2008 to 12/2016; Project Manager at Scanmoor, 6/2005 to 12/2007

career.title: PMO - Project Delivery Lead - Cost & Project Manager

education: MSc/PGDip, Quantity Surveying, London South Bank University, 2012 to 2013
Bachelor’s Degree, eCommerce, Munster Technological University, 2001 to 2005
biography: Analytical and performance driven Cost & Project Manager with over twenty years progressive experience providing direct support to ensure the optimization of commercial interests for the business. Highly skilled at managing and coordinating between multidisciplinary teams. International experience gained in the USA, UK, and Ireland. Well diversified in working in a challenging environment and dealing with both internal and external stakeholders, contractors, clients, and design teams. Proven history of success in establishing and negotiating the contractual agreements of the company, as well as scheduling and tracking all construction works to ensure an optimal allocation of business resources. Expert at formulating and implementing solutions to effect dramatic improvements in efficiency, productivity, and business processes toward the successful attainment of pre-established goals through the assistance of the latest PMIS tools, such as Procore & eBuilder, P6 Scheduling & Bluebeam estimating. Committed to developing accurate estimates and expense budgets, within excel & other available software. Communicating with all relevant parties to ensure clear and consistent program controls. Dealing with problems head on, leading by example and setting a high benchmark for others to follow. Improving the business by continually reviewing and compiling a lesson learnt report. Adjusting processes as agreed with company executives to better control costs and ensure any contractual issues are addressed and avoided in future.
